title: Crestline Fleet Account Over-Limit Dispute Amount
content:
**Amount in dispute.** The amount a business on a Crestline Fleet Account may place in dispute as an unapproved over-limit ticket is the invoice amount less the account's ticket approval limit, never below 0.00 and never more than the invoice amount, rounded half up to the cent.

## Terms of the calculation

- **The invoice** is the fleet invoice the business's most recent remittance was applied to; the invoice amount is that invoice's posted amount (after the fleet discount).
- **The ticket approval limit** is the account's own ticket approval limit as it stands on the account.
- **The measured amount** is the invoice amount.
- **The authorized amount** is the account's ticket approval limit.
- **The unapproved part** is the measured amount less the authorized amount, never below 0.00.
- **The disputed amount** is the unapproved part, never below 0.00 and never more than the invoice amount, rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

| Invoice amount | Ticket approval limit | Unapproved part | Amount in dispute |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1234.56 | 1000.00 | 234.56 | 234.56 |
| 812.30 | 1000.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| 1000.00 | 1000.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

In the first line the invoice amount exceeds the limit by 234.56, which is less than the invoice amount, so the whole difference is the amount in dispute. In the second and third the invoice does not exceed the limit, and the amount never falls below 0.00.

## Basis questions

- *Which invoice does the calculation read?* The invoice the most recent remittance was applied to.
- *Whose limit is used, the program default or the account's?* The account's ticket approval limit.
